name: kt-showcase-video
description: 2-minute Remotion showcase of the new kavaiyatech.com

scripts.render: node scripts/music.mjs && remotion render KTShowcase out/kt-showcase.mp4 --audio-bitrate=320k
scripts.render:4k: node scripts/music.mjs && remotion render KTShowcase out/kt-showcase-4k.mp4 --scale=2 --audio-bitrate=320k
scripts.render:best: node scripts/music.mjs && remotion render KTShowcase out/kt-showcase-1080p.mp4 --gl=angle-egl --image-format=png --crf=12 --x264-preset=veryslow --pixel-format=yuv420p --color-space=bt709 --audio-bitrate=320k
